Conjunctive waw | Noun - proper - feminine singular
d: Javan, the name of a son of Joktan, and of the race (Ionians, i.e. Greeks) descended from him, with their territory; also of a place in Arabia
r: probably from the same as H3196 (יַיִן); effervescing (i.e. hot and active);
